JTs Hud with the **AI Director** addon: an automatic observer that moves the CS2 camera like a professional broadcast observer, with an optional AI layer (any OpenAI-compatible API) and a broadcast overlay. See the [README](https://github.com/xFiveClub/JTs-Hud#ai-director) for setup.

### Downloads

| File                          | Use                                           |
| ----------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `jts-hud-<version>-setup.exe` | Windows installer (recommended)               |
| `jts-hud-<version>-win.zip`   | Portable: unzip and run `JTs Hud Manager.exe` |

> **Windows SmartScreen:** the installer is not code-signed, so Windows may show "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info → Run anyway**.

### Quick start

1. Install, open the app and install the GSI cfg from **Settings**.
2. Add `-netconport 2020` to the CS2 launch options and spectate the match.
3. Open **AI Director** and press **Start Director** (`Alt+D`).

Based on [JohnTimmermann/JTs-Hud](https://github.com/JohnTimmermann/JTs-Hud) 7.13.26 · GPL-3.0
